headlines.text: Looking back to 2021, when Adam Page vs. Andrade El Idolo vs. Jon Moxley vs. Lance Archer vs. Matt Hardy vs. Orange Cassidy vs. PAC settled things in a Casino Ladder match, headlining the show on Dynamite, rated 8.22 ? a genuinely great match, on an outstanding Anniversary '21 show that earned an overall rating of 8.73. Dynamite's 2nd anniversary showcase, and the surprise return of the "joker" entrant ? Hangman Page made a triumphant comeback, fighting through the whole ladder gauntlet to win a future AEW World Title shot, on a night that also officially announced the brand-new TBS Championship.
On this day in 2023, Lince Dorado kicked off their AEW journey against Komander vs. Johnny TV vs. Penta El Zero M, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.81.
Back on this day in 2021, Bobby Fish laced up for their first AEW match against Sammy Guevara, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.42.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2021, when Anniversary '21 stood out as one of AEW's best-received shows of the year, rated 8.73.
On a Wednesday in 2021, back when it was a welcome sight as Serena Deeb returned to the ring after just under 5 months away, appearing on Dynamite.

Turning the clock back to 2023: Trent Beretta reached a genuine milestone: their 50th match in AEW, facing Best Friends vs. The Hardys vs. 2.O vs. Chuck Taylor vs. Trent Beretta vs. Jeff Hardy vs. Matt Hardy vs. Angelo Parker vs. Matt Menard vs. Daniel Garcia vs. Jake Hager, kicking off the show on Rampage, rated 5.27.
